posts.text: Banger paper from NVIDIA. AI agents just built an entire deep learning framework from scratch. This new research introduces VibeTensor, an open-source deep learning stack fully generated by LLM-powered coding agents under high-level human guidance. This demonstrates that coding agents can generate coherent system software crossing abstraction boundaries from Python APIs down to CUDA memory management, validated entirely through automated builds and tests.
posts.notes: VibeTensor paper coverage: NVIDIA agents generating 218 C++/CUDA files (63,543 LOC) — full deep learning stack. Crosses abstraction boundaries. 27K views, 369 bookmarks. Proof that coding agents can build coherent complex systems end-to-end.
